title: Stardust 3-in-1: Terracendiscape
description: When 3 dimensions are too much, explore them all in the same dimension!
body:
This is an April Fool's joke datapack! Do not install it on a world you care about...

# Stardust 3-in-1: Terracendiscape

Terralith, Incendium, and Nullscape are all very cool. But it takes a lot of work have to upload three separate datapacks into your world. And then you have to swap dimensions to explore them all? That's so much work...

What if you could install only one (1) datapack, and explore only one (1) dimension, but get the experience of all three? Look no further!
